wholePhysicalScope: Named native way 24059735 fixes the principal walls, transepts, annex and faceted east apse. Three cleared exterior photos control the open west portico, upper clock stage, arched openings, oculi and east annex.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the portico, two transepts, apsidal roof and every stage of the tower. Window divisions, columns and clock ornament reduce with distance.
limitations: December 2025 exterior. The surviving east form is guided by two cleared 2008 photographs. Interiors and surrounding grounds are outside the asset.
Secondary roof junctions, fine clock ornament, window tracery and individual stone courses are approximate.
The original terrain is retained. Foundation and individual threshold heights are approximate.
